༄༅/ /nyon mongs pa'i kun 'byung gi rnam gzhag mdor bsdus gsal ba bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: / nyon mongs pa'i kun 'byung gi rnam gzhag mdor bsdus gsal ba bzhugs/ blang dang dor bya'i chos rnams ma lus pa/ /mngon sum gzigs nas gzhan la thugs brtse bas/ /legs par 'doms mdzad zla med ston pa dang*/ /rje btsun mkhyen pa'i gter gyi zhabs la 'dud/ /rgyal bas gsungs pa'i chos mngon gzhung lugs kun/ /ji bzhin gsal mdzad thog med sku mched sogs/ /'dzam gling mkhas pa rnams la gus btud nas/ /mngon pa'i gzhung don cha tsam brjod par bya/ /de yang thar 'dod kyi skyes bus bden bzhi'i nang tshan gyi sdug kun gnyis kyi rnam gzhag legs par shes dgos pa yin te/ sdug bden gyi rnam dbye mi shes shing ma bsams na de las thar 'dod kyi nges 'byung khyad par can mi skye zhing*/ kun 'byung gi rnam dbye mi shes na 'khor ba'i rtsa ba gang yin der gcod tshul mi shes pa'i phyir te/ lam rim bsdus don las/ sdug bden nyes dmigs bsam la ma 'bad na/ /thar ba don gnyer ji bzhin mi skye zhing*/ /kun 'byung 'khor ba'i 'jug rim ma bsams nas/ /'khor ba'i rtsa ba gcod tshul mi shes pas/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de dag gi rnam gzhag ni mngon pa gong 'og gi gzhung las 'byung ba ltar/ phar phyin dang lam rim sogs nas kyang ci rigs bshad cing*/ bdag gis kyang mdzod kyi ṭīkka dang*/ las kyi rnam gzhag sogs las ci ltar rigs par brjod zin na'ang*/ 'dir nyon mongs kyi rnam gzhag mdor bsdus zhig sgos su 'chad pa la gsum/ nyon mongs pa'i dbye ba spyir bstan pa/ bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rgyal bas nyon mongs pa brgyad khri bzhi stong gi gnyer por chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs pa ltar na/ nyon mongs pa'i phyogs la'ang brgyad khri bzhi stong yod de/ gnyen po dang grangs mtshungs par 'dod chags kyis sder gtogs nyis khri chig stong*/ de bzhin du zhe sdang gti mug dang*/

dug gsum gang rung cha mnyam pa'i sder gtogs nyis khri chig stong ste khyon brgyan khri bzhi stong yod pa'i phyir te/ mdzod las/ spyod pa rnams kyi gnyen por ni/ /chos kyi phung po mthun par gsungs/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa la bzhi/ mtshan nyid/ sgra bshad/ byed las/ dbye ba'o/ /dang po ni rang dang mtshungs ldan gyi sems rgyud ma zhi bar byed pa'i rigs su gnas pa'i sems byung de/ nyon mongs pa'i mtshan nyid/ rigs gnas sbyar ba'i dgos pa yod de/ byang sems 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi nyon mongs pas de'i sems rgyud la zhi bar mi byed pa'i phyir te/ de'i rgyud kyi nyon mongs pa rnams ni sman dang sngags kyis bcom pa'i dug ltar nus pa chung ba'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ sems blong blong por byed pa'am ma zhi bar byed pas na nyon mongs pa zhes bya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ nyon mongs gzhan dang las bskyed cing rgyun brtan pa dang gnas par byed pa sogs so/ /bzhi pa dbye na bzhi ste/ ngo bo'i sgo nas rtsa ba'i nyon mongs drug nye ba'i nyon mongs nyi shu/ rnam pa'i sgo nas bcu/ khams kyi sgo nas go brgyad do/ /dang po rtsa nyon drug ni/ mdzod las/ srid pa'i rtsa ba phra rgyas drug/'dod chags de bzhin khong khro dang*/ /nga rgyal ma rig lta ba dang*/ /the tshom yin te zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de yang rtsa nyon du gyur ba'i 'dod chags dang*/ khong khro dang*/ nga rgyal dang*/ ma rig pa dang*/ lta ngan dang*/ the tshom nyon mongs can dang drug go /dang po 'dod chags ni/ zag bcas kyi dngos po la chags pa'i sems byung ngo*/ /gnyis pa khong khro ni/ sems can nam tsher ma sogs kun nas mnar sems kyi gzhi la dmigs pa'i sems byung rtsub pa'i rnam pa can no/ /gsum pa nga rgyal ni 'jig lta la brten nas yul mtho dma' bar gsum ci rigs la dmigs nas sems khengs pa'i rnam pa can gyi sems byung ngo/ /bzhi pa ma rig pa ni/

bden bzhi dang las 'bras sogs la rmongs pa dang rig pa ye shes kyi 'gal zlar gyur pa'i sems byung rmongs pa'o/ /lnga pa the tshom nyon mongs can ni/ dkon mchog dang las 'bras sogs yod pa'i don la yid gnyis za ba'i sems byung ngo*/ /drug pa lta ba nyon mongs can la lnga yod pa'i/ dang po 'jig lta ni/ nyer len gyi phung po la dmigs nas nga dang nga'i zhes bdag dang bdag gir lta ba'i sems byung shes rab nyon mongs can no/ /gnyis pa mthar lta ni/ 'jig ltas bzung ba'i bdag de la dmigs nas rtag par lta ba'am 'di nas nyid mtshams sbyor bar med pa'i chad par lta ba'i shes rab nyon mongs can no/ /gsum pa lta ba mchog 'dzin ni/ lta ba dman pa la lta ba mchog tu rlom zhing zhen pa'i sems byung shes rab nyon mongs can no/ /bzhi pa log lta ni/ tshe lnga phyi dang las 'bras sogs yod pa'i don la med par lta ba'am med pa'i don la yod par lta ba'i sems byung shes rab nyon mongs can no/ /lnga pa tshul khrims dang brtul zhugs mchog 'dzin ni/ tshul khrims ngan pa dang brtul zhugs dman pa la mchog tu 'dzin pa'i sems byung shes rab nyon mongs can no/ /snga ma drug la rtsa nyon zhes brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ srid pa'i rtsa ba'am rgyu'i gtso bo byed pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis yin pa'i phyir/ ma rig pa las gzhan rnams 'khor ba'i rtsa ba dngos min te/ gzhung gzhan nas 'khor ba'i rtsa ba la ma rig pas khyab par bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /ma rig pa thams cad kyang 'khor ba'i rtsa ba min te/ de kho na nyid la rmongs pa'i ma rig pa ma gtogs gzhan las 'bras sogs la rmongs pa'i ma rig pa ni 'khor ba'i rtsa bar mi rung ba'i phyir te/ 'khor ba'i rtsa ba la 'dzin stangs mi mthun pa gnyis med pa'i phyir ro/ /gang zag gi bdag med pa'i de kho na nyid la rmongs pa'i ma rig pa thams cad kyang 'khor ba'i rtsa ba min te/ byang 'phags kyi rgyud kyi gang zag gi bdag 'dzin rnams ma rig pa yin kyang 'khor ba'i rtsa ba ma yin pa'i phyir ro/

rang rgyud pa man chad dngos po bden par 'dzin pa'i bden 'dzin ma rig par mi 'dod kyang thal 'gyur ba'i lugs la de ma rig pa yin pa'i tshul shes dgos so/ /ma rig pa dang 'dod chags gang rung yin na/ rtsa nyon yin mi dgos te/ byang 'phags kyi rgyud la de gnyis yod pa'i phyir te/ byang 'phags kyis 'dod gzugs kyi 'dod chags gzhan don sgrub pa'i yan lag tu bsgyur bar byed pa'i phyir ro/ /rtsa nyon gyi nang tshan gyi 'dod chags dang*/ khong khro dang*/ ma rig pa gsum ni dug gsum la byed pa yin te/ 'dod chags rang ming gis shes la/ khong khro zhe sdang dang*/ ma rig pa gti mug yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod chags zhes pa ni da lta 'dod chags su grags pa'i dbang po gnyis sbyor la brten pa'i 'dod chags tsam min gyi/ gzugs sgra sogs 'dod yon rnams la chags pa'i sred pa sogs zag bcas kyi dngos po la sred pas zhen pa'i sems byung thams cad kyang 'dod chags yin no/ khong khro ni go sla la/ gti mug la dkon mchog gam las 'bras bden bzhi sogs blang dor gyi gnas rags pa la rmongs pa dang*/ chos dang gang zag gi bdag med pa'i de kho na nyid la rmongs pa'i gti mug gnyis yod do/ /nga rgyal la mnyam ba'i nga rgyal/ lhag pa'i nga rgyal/ nga rgyal las kyang nga rgyal/ nga'o mnyam pa'i nga rgyal/ cung zad snyam pa'i nga rgyal/ log pa'i nga rgyal dang bdun no/ /nyon mongs par kun bslangs te rigs rus longs spyod yon tan sogs gang rung gi sgo nas bdag mi 'di dang mnyam/ 'di las lhag 'di las ches khyad par du 'phags/ rang gi phung po la dmigs nas nga'o snyam pa dang*/ yon tan de ma thob kyang thob zin no snyam pa dang*/ bdag khyad 'phags de bas cung zad tsam zhig dman snyam pa dang*/ yon tan min pa la yon tan du rlom pa rnams so/ /'di dag la nga rgyal dngos min pa'ang yod do/ /the tshom la spyir nyon mongs can dang min pa gnyis yod kyang las 'bras rags pa dang dkon mchog gsum dang bden bzhi rags pa la yod dam med phal cher med snyam du the tshom za ba ni nyon mongs can mi dge ba yin la/

las 'bras phra mo sogs blang dor gyi gnas shin tu rtogs dka' ba la yod med the tshom za ba lta bu the tshom lung ma bstan du 'gyur zhing*/ las 'bras phra mo rnams yod med gang yin mi shes kyang gzhan gyis yod par bstan pa na yod dam snyam pa'i don 'gyur gyi the tshom ni dge bar 'gyur ro/ /'jig lta sogs lta ba lnga po gcig tu bsdus pa la lta ba nyon mongs can zhes rtsa nyon du 'dren pas rtsa nyon drug go / gnyis pa nye nyon la nyi shu yod pa'i/ dang po khro ba ni/ gnod byed la yid 'khrugs pa'i sems byung btags yod/ gnyis pa 'khon 'dzin ni sngar gyi gnod byed la sha gnyer ba mi gtong ba'i sems byung*/ gsum pa 'chab pa ni/ kha na ma tho pa zur gyis sbaid pa'i sems byung*/ sems byung zhes pa gzhan la'ang sbyar te/ bzhi pa 'tshig pa ni/ khro bas rgyu byas te tshig rtsub 'dren pa/ lnga pa phrag dog ni/ gzhan gyi phun tshogs la yid khong nas 'khrugs pa/ drug pa ser sna ni/ zag bcas kyi dngos po la dam du 'dzin pa/ bdun pa sgyu ni/ nyes pa mi mngon par gzhan du sgyur bar byed pa/ brgyad pa g.yo ni/ yon tan de dang mi ldan bzhin du ldan pa ltar ston pa/ dgu pa rgyags pa ni/ rang gi yo byad sogs la chags shing dregs pa/ bcu pa rnam 'tshe ni/ gzhan la gnod sems bsam pas tho 'tsham bar 'dod pa/ bcu gcig pa ngo tsha med pa ni/ rang ngam chos rgyu mtshan du byas nas kha na ma tho ba la mi 'dzem pa/ bcu gnyis pa khrel med pa ni/ gzhan gyis 'phya ba'i nyes pa la mi 'dzem pa/ bcu gsum pa rmugs pa ni/ lus sems blong blong bor byed pa/ bcu bzhi pa rgod pa ni/ dmigs pa rtse gcig pa las sems 'phro zhing zhi bar byed pa can/ bco lnga pa ma dad pa ni/ yon tan can nam yon tan dang blang dor gyi gnas sogs la mi gus pa/ bcu drug pa le lo ni/ dge ba'i bya ba la mi spro ba/ bcu bdun pa bag med ni/ rang dgar spyod pa phyin ci log tu byed pa/

bco brgyad pa brjed nges ni/ dge ba'i dmigs rnam brjed par byed pa/ bcu dgu pa shes bzhin ma yin pa ni/ dge ba'i bya ba de legs par mi shes pa'am shes kyang dran pa g.yeng nas 'jug pa/ nyi shu pa rnam g.yeng ni/ dge ba'i dmigs pa las yid phyir 'phro bar byed pa'i sems 'byung ngo*/ /'di dag la nye nyon zhes brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ rtsa nyon dang nye ba'i nyon mongs yin pas de ltar du brjod pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyid dang*/ 'gyod pa dang*/ rtog dpyod gnyis te bzhi la ni nyon mongs yin min gnyis yod do/ /rtsa nyon dang nye nyon gang yin kyang sems byung yin dgos pas/ de dag gang gi 'khor du phyed pa'i sems de nyon mongs can lta bu yin kyang nyon mongs min no/ nye nyon de dag ni gtso bor mngon pa kun btus dang*/ phung po lnga'i rab byed nas bshad pa ltar yin la/ 'dzod las/ rmongs pa dang*/ bag med dang*/ le lo dang*/ ma dad pa dang*/ rgod pa ste drug la nyon mongs chen po'i sa pa dang*/ khro ba/ 'khon 'dzin/ g.yo/ phrag doga'atshig pa/ 'chab pa/ ser sna/ sgyu/ rgyags pa/ rnam par 'tshe ba ste bcu la mi dge ba chen po'i sa pa dang*/ khong khro/ nga rgyal/ ngo tsha med pa/ khrel med pa rnams la yang mi dge ba'i sa par bshad do/ /gnyis pa rnams pa'i sgo nas bcu ni/ sngar bshad pa'i lta ba lnga dang*/ lta min snga ste bcu'o/ /gsum pa khams kyi sgo nas phye na/ 'dod pa'i sas bsdus pa'i sdug bsngal mthong spangs lta ba lnga lta min lnga ste bcu dang*/ kun 'byung 'gog pa mthong spang la 'jig lta mthar lta tshul zhugs mchog 'dzin gyi lta ba gsum dor nas gzhan bdun bdun te nyer gcig dang*/ lam mthong spang la 'jig lta mthar lta ma gtogs gzhan brgyad de khyon so drug go /'dod chags khong khro nga rgyal ma rig pa bzhi ni sgom spang ngo*/ khams gong ma gnyis na khong khro ma gtogs gzhan so lnga re yod pa ni sngar dang 'dra zhing*/

thams cad khyon bsdoms na go brgyad do/ /tshul 'dis khams gong ma gnyis kyi gang zag gi rgyud la'ang khong khro mngon 'gyur ba med par go bar bya ste/ mdzod las/ khong khro ma gtogs de dag nyid/ /gzugs dang gzugs med de dang 'dra/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa 'phros ni rgyas par bshad na mang yang*/ bsdu na/ nyon mongs de rnams las mi dge ba ni gang*/ lung ma bstan ni gang zhe na/ yod de/ mdzod las/ gong ma thams cad lung ma bstan/ /'dod na 'jig tshogs lta ba dang*/ /mthar 'dzin lhan cig ma rig pa/ /lhag ma rnams 'dir mi dge'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ khams gong ma gnyis kyi nyon mongs thams cad sgrib lung ma bstan yin te/ sgrib pa yin yang sa de'i ting nge 'dzin gyi nus pas btul bas rnam smin 'byin pa'i nus pa med pa'i phyir ro/ /'dod pa'i 'jig lta mthar lta gnyis dang*/ de gnyis dang mtshungs ldan gyi ma rig pa rnams kyang sgrib lung ma bstan yin zhing*/ de gsum las lhag ma phra rgyas 'dod chags/ zhe sdang khong khro/ the tshom nyon mongs can/ log lta/ lta ba mchog 'dzin/ tshul zhugs mchog 'dzin/ nye nyon nyi shu po phal cher yang mi dge ba yin la/ rtsa nyon re gnyis la zhib cha dbye dgos pa'ang yod do/ khams gong ma gnyis na gzugs sgra sogs 'dod yon la chags pa'i 'dod chags med cing*/ ting nge 'dzin la sred pa'i 'dod chags yod kyang mi dge ba min te lung ma bstan no/ /bdag med pa'i de kho na nyid la rmongs pa'i ma rig pa rnams ni rnam smin mi 'byin pas lung ma bstan yin la/ las 'bras rags pa la rmongs pa'i ma rig pa phal cher mi dge bar sems te/ gong du drangs pa'i mdzod kyi lung des/ lta ngan gnyis mtshungs ldan gyi ma rig pa de lung ma bstan du dmigs kyis bkar nas bshad pas go ba'i phyir ro/ /phyin ci log bzhi dang lta ngan gzhan drug cu rtsa bzhi ni/ 'jig lta mthar lta log lta gsum las phye ba yin pas log lta las phye ba rnams ni mi dge ba'o/

/rtsa nyon dang nye nyon de dag la phra rgyas zhes bya ste/ dmigs pa dang mtshungs ldan gnyis kyi sgo nas nyon mongs pa'i bag la nyal phra ba'ang rgyas par byed pa'i phyir/ nyon mongs de dag gis 'khor bar 'jog par byed pa'i phyir zag pa dang*/ skye gnas bzhir 'khyer bar byed pa'i phyir chu bo dang*/ der 'byar bar byed pa'i phyir kun sbyor dang*/ der nye bar 'dzin pa'i phyir nye bar len pa zhes nges tshig gis bshad do/ /gzhan yang 'dod pa la 'dun pa/ gnod sems/ 'jig lta/ tshul zhugs mchog 'dzin/ the tshom nyon mongs can lngas 'dod khams las 'da' mi nus par byed pa'i phyir tha ma'i cha mthun lnga zhes bya la/ khams gong ma'i 'dod chags gnyis/ rgod pa/ nga rgyal/ rmongs pa lngas khams gong ma gnyis las 'da' mi nus par byed pa'i phyir gong ma'i cha mthun lnga zhes brjod/ 'jig lta/ tshul zhugs mchog 'dzin/ the tshom nyon mongs can gsum la kun sbyor gsum zhes bya ste/ rim pa bzhin du thar bar 'gro mi 'dod pa dang*/ lam nor pa dang*/ yang dag pa'i lam la the tshom za ba'i sgo nas lam log par sbyor bar byed pa'i phyir ro/ /kun dkris zhes pa ni nyon mongs spyi'i ming du bshad kyang*/ mdzod las/ ngo tsha med pa dang*/ khrel med/ phrag dog ser sna/ rgod pa/ 'gyod pa/ rmugs pa/ gnyid/ khro ba/ 'chab pa bcu la kun dkris so zhes sger du bshad de/ sems nyon mongs pa'i phyogs su kun nas dkri ste 'ching bar byed pa'i phyir ro/ 'on kyang 'gyod pa la gnyis te dge ba la 'gyod pa nyon mongs pa dang mi dge ba yin gyi/ gnyid dus dge ba byed pa la dga' ba'i gnyid lta bu ni dge ba yin pas khyad par dbye bar bya'o/ /nyon mongs skye ba'i rten ni nyon mongs pa'i bag la nyalo/ /dmigs pa ni/ nyon mongs pa skye bar 'gyur ba'i yul rnams snang ba dang*/ sdug mi sdug gi mtshan ma yid la byed pa sogs mang ngo*/ nyes dmigs ni/ nyon mongs pa'i dbang gis tshe 'dir mi 'dod pa du ma bskyed cing des mi dge ba'i las bsags nas tshe phyi ma la sdug bsngal sna tshogs thob par 'gyur ba sogs so/

/'khor bar skye ba'i rgyu la las nyon mongs gnyis yod kyang nyon mongs gtso bo yin te/ lam rim chen mo las/ 'khor ba 'grub pa'i rgyu la las dang nyon mongs pa gnyis dgos kyang*/ nyon mongs pa gtso bo yin te/ nyon mongs med na sngar bsags kyi las bgrang las 'das pa yod kyang rlan dang sa la sogs pa med pa'i sa bon gyis myu gu mi 'grub pa bzhin du/ las la lhan cig byed rkyen med pas sdug bsngal gyi myu gu mi 'grub pa'i phyir dang*/ nyon mongs yod na las sngar bsags med kyang de ma thag gsar du bsags nas phung po phyi ma len pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar yang*/ rnam 'grel las/ srid pa'i sred las rnam brgal ba'i/ /las gzhan 'phen nus ma yin te/ /lhan cig byed pa zad phyir ro/ /zhes dang*/ sred pa ni yod na slar yang 'byung phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes 'byung ba ltar te/ nyon mongs pa'i nang nas sred pa 'khor ba 'grub pa'i gtso bo yin par bshad do/ /'on kyang*/ rten 'brel bstod pa las/ 'jig rten rgud pa ji snyed pa/ /de yi rtsa ba ma rig ste/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar dang po'i rtsa ba'i rgyu'i dbang du byas na ni ma rig pa gtso bo yin te/ ma rig pa yod na nyon mongs pa gzhan dang las dang sred len sogs yan lag gzhan rnams kyang skye bar 'gyur zhing*/ ma rig pa med na las gsog pa med la/ las gsog pa med na sred len nas rga shi'i bar mi 'byung ba'i kun byang gi rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyi go rim nges pa'-i phyir ro/ / spong tshul la gnyis te/ so so'i dbang du byas na/ 'dod chags kyi gnyen por mi sdug pa/ zhe sdang ngam khong khro'i gnyen por byams pa/ gti mug gi gnyen por rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyi lugs 'byung lugs ldog dang*/ nga rgyal la gnyis/ dang po rigs rus longs spyod sogs kyis dregs pa'i nga rgyal gyi gnyen por de rnams mi rtag cing 'bral ba'i chos can dang*/

thos pas dregs pa'i nga rgyal gyi gnyen por shes bya'i khams kyi rnams pa dang rab dbye mtha' yas pa'i tshul sems pa dang*/ phrag dog gi gnyen por 'gran sems med cing btang snyoms bsgom pa dang*/ lta ngan gyi gnyen por yang dag pa'i lta ba sgom pa sogs dang*/ yang nyon mongs de dag gi nyes dmigs sems pa sogs mang du yod kyang*/ nyon mongs spong ba'i gnyen po thams cad kyi gtso bo ni bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab nyid yin te/ shes rab de nyid gtso bor bsgoms na nyon mongs pa thams cad kyi rtsa ba ma rig pa spong nus shing*/ de spangs na nyon mongs pa gzhan thams cad rang shugs kyis ldog par 'gyur ba'i phyir te/ 'di la mdo bstan bcos kyi khungs mang yang mtshon tsam ni/ 'phags pas chos dbyings bstod pa las/ yang dag mthong phyir dngos stong par/ /legs shes ma rig mi 'byung ba/ /de ni ma rig 'gag pa yin/ /de phyir yan lag bcu gnyis 'gag /zhes dang*/ bzhi brgya pa las/ de phyir nyon mongs thams cad kyang*/ /gti mug bcom pas bcom par 'gyur/ /zhes dang*/ spyod 'jug las/ yan lag 'di dag thams cad ni/ /thub pas shes rab don du gsungs/ /de yi phyir na sdug bsngal dag /zhi bar 'dod pas shes rab bskyed/ /zhes dang*/ lam gyi gtso bo rnam gsum las/ gnas lugs rtogs pa'i shes rab mi ldan na/ /nges 'byung byang chub sems la goms byas kyang*/ /srid pa'i rtsa ba gcod bar mi nus pas/ /de phyir rten 'brel rtogs pa'i thabs la 'bad/ /zhes dang*/ rnam 'grel las kyang*/ stong nyid lta bas grol 'gyur gyis/ sgom pa lhag ma de don yin/ /zhes dang*/ shes rab de gsung rab kun las bsngags pa yin te/ bsdus don yang*/ shes rab zab mo'i de nyid lta ba'i mig /srid pa'i rtsa ba drung nas 'byin pa'i lam/ /gsung rab kun las bsngags pa'i yon tan gter/ /gti mug mug sel sgron me mchog tu grags/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/

/rgyu mtshan de'i phyir las nyon mongs gnyis kyi nang nas nyon mongs spong dgos pa che mod/ 'on kyang bsdus don las/ lhag par las sgrib sbyong ba gnad che bas/ /zhes gsungs pa ni/ da lta'i gang zag gis nyon mongs rtsa ba nas bcad de spong mi nus/ las sgrib sbyong ba'i tshul la gtso bor 'bad dgos pa'i don no/ /smras pa/ rigs drug 'khor ba'i sems can rnams/ /srid rtse nas bzung dmyal ba'i bar/ /mgal me'i 'khor lo ltar 'khor ba'i/ /rgyu rkyen las dang nyon mongs so/ /zhe sdang sred sogs nyon mongs la/ /rkang lag yod pa ma yin zhing*/ /dpa' 'dzangs min yang ci zhig ltar/ /'gro 'di rang dbang med par 'khrid/ /de phyir nyon mongs chom rkun ni/ /gnyen po'i mdung gis bzlog dgos kyi/ /gzhan du mngon mtho nges legs nor/ /'dis 'phrog 'gyur bar gdon mi 'tshal/ /de la nyon mongs ngo bo dang*/ /dbye ba skye nyes spong tshul sogs/ /shes dgos mi shes mun rdo ltar/ /'gyur phyir 'dir de'i rnam gzhag bris/ /ces nyon mongs pa'i kun 'byung gi rnam gzhag mdor bsdus pa 'di yang*/ shākya'i dge slong bshad sgrub ming can gyis don gnyer can re gnyis la phan srid snyam nas co ne'i dgon nyid du dad pas sbyar ba ste/ dad dang rnam dpyod ldan pa'i 'bo ra'i rab 'byams pas par du bsgrubs pa'i dge bas las nyon las grol bar gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ/ shubhaṃ// //
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/nyon mongs pa'i kun 'byung gi rnam gzhag mdor bsdus gsal ba bzhugs/ -PAGE 184--PAGE 183--PAGE 172-
